sec: Structural and non-structural genes, infection sources and modes of transmission

items.q: Fill up: the HIV genome is printed as '______ copies of ssRNA'.

Structural genes — match the gene to its product — 1) env 2) pol 3) gag … A) Reverse transcriptase, integrase and protease B) p17 matrix protein and p24 core protein C) gp120 spike protein and gp41 transmembrane pedicle protein
items.exp: 'Env : codes gp120 (Spike protein), gp41 (Transmembrane pedicle protein); POL : codes Enzymes : Reverse transcriptase, Integrase, Protease; GAG : codes P17 (matrix protein), P24 (Core protein / nucleocapsid protein)'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Non-structural genes — match — 1) Nef 2) Vif 3) Rev 4) Tat … A) Viral infectivity factor B) Regulation of viral expression C) Transcription activator D) Negative effector, downregulates host CD4 cells
items.exp: '· Nef/P : Negative effector → Downregulates host CD4 cells; · vif : Viral infectivity factor; Rev : Regulation of viral expression; Tat : Transcription activator'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Which gene is printed as downregulating host CD4 cells?
items.exp: '· Nef/P : Negative effector → Downregulates host CD4 cells'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Which two accessory proteins are printed at the end of the non-structural gene list?
items.exp: The list ends with Vpr (viral protein R) and 'Vpu / Vpx'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Infection sources — match the concentration to the fluid — 1) Highest 2) As high as blood 3) Low … A) Semen and vaginal fluid B) Tears, saliva, urine and breast milk C) Blood, pus from sores and CSF
items.exp: 'High concentration : · Blood, · Semen/vaginal fluid (As high as blood), · Pus from sores, CSF'; 'Low concentration : Tears, Saliva (SLIP), urine, Breast milk'. (Book p1063)

items.q: What expansion is printed for SLIP in the low-concentration list?
Which body fluid is printed as carrying as high a viral concentration as blood?
items.exp: '· Semen/vaginal fluid (As high as blood)'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Which mode of transmission is printed first in the mode-of-transmission list?
items.exp: 'Sexual > Parent to child > IV drug abuse > Blood transfusion > Needle stick'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Which exposure is printed as carrying the maximum per-exposure risk, and at what figure?
items.exp: 'maximum : Blood transfusion (9250/10,000) > Parent to child > IV drug abuse > Needle stick'. (Book p1063)

items.q: Judge the transmission page: I Sexual transmission outranks parent-to-child, IV drug use, transfusion and needlestick in frequency. II Per exposure, transfusion carries the highest risk.
items.exp: 'Sexual > Parent to child > IV drug abuse > Blood transfusion > Needle stick' and 'maximum : Blood transfusion (9250/10,000)'. (Book p1063)
